name: Mizunashi Arata
source:
"I'm Arata... Arata Mizunashi. Looks like there's a big mess... again. Is this the first time? Or the third? I can't really tell. I'll be counting on your power to cross the worlds. Don't worry--I'll be doing my part, too! ...Wait, is she going to read this comment? That's not good! No details for now. Catch you later!"

A brilliant programmer who was the lead at Iris Corporation. [url=/c160573]Shiina's[/url] best friend and precious partner.

However, he has mysteriously vanished, and only a few at Iris Corp. know the truth. Technically, it's not a disappearance, but a "leave of absence." His friends continue to believe in his return. After all, he plays a critical role in keeping the world looping. A loop designed to end the loop... how ironic.

Even without him, Director Shiina and his protégé [url=/c160574]Mai[/url] are doing well as programmers, so development hasn't suffered too much. Though that's kind of sad in its own way, haha!

[url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] will likely encounter him near the story's climax.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category8&ch=arata]official website[/url]]
